items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: the man that owns it and the promoter, his name was, let's see, Arnetta

ctx.x: take it right through. Through everything.

On the trip to the Orient, we came back through -- we came to Manila and we played a large stadium in Manila; the man that owns it and the promoter, his name was, let's see, Arnetta -- he was supposed to be the wealthiest man in Manila. Now when he brings an act in, he finds out what type of automobile everybody in the group drives, and that's your car when you're in Manila. They meet you at the airport, you know, and if you drive a Chrysler, there's a Chrysler there for you. I was a Mercedes man, and there was a…

But he had 39 automobiles. 39 automobiles. But he had this palatial mansion, and he had a couple of -- they weren't kids, they were adults -- but one was going to Georgetown University, and both of them played golf, so you know, I was right at home. We played that country club over there quite a bit, but ...
